en: The postcard features two black-and-white photographs. The upper image shows a building set on a grassy slope, surrounded by trees and garden, with a notable round domed tower (possibly part of a monument or observatory) visible in the background. The lower image shows an outdoor garden scene with several tables and chairs under trees and large parasols, giving a cozy, relaxing atmosphere reminiscent of a German beer garden or café terrace. The style of architecture and landscape suggests a European setting. There is handwritten/decorative German script on the card.
